title: SysAdminSuite Cybernet Topology Evidence Bundle
description: Portable topology evidence one technician can hand to another so a colleague's survey starts from accumulated context instead of rework. Carries deployment topology evidence only; it never asserts device hardware identity.

source_run_id.description: Run id of the session that produced this bundle.

contains_operator_local_data.description: Always true. Bundles hold site and CIDR context, so they stay in local ignored paths or approved internal channels and are never committed.

registry.description: A sas-cybernet-deployment-topology-registry/v1 payload with computed eligibility stripped. The receiving session always recomputes eligibility locally.
